prompt:
Use case: photographic source triptych for the Hanzi vocabulary word cloud; three separate photographs to be cropped later.
Primary request: Create one photorealistic 1024 by 1792 pixel vertical image containing exactly three distinct edge-to-edge landscape photographic rows stacked top, middle, bottom. Equal row heights, with straight horizontal scene changes at approximately y=597 and y=1195. Each row is an independent landscape photograph filling the complete width; no gutters, borders, frames, margins, labels, text or watermark.
Top row: real clouds above a small grassy hill. The hill is small and low in the frame; the broad cloud-filled sky is clearly the main subject.
Middle row: real clouds above a modest real house. The house occupies a small lower portion of the photograph; the expansive sky and clouds clearly dominate rather than the building.
Bottom row: real clouds above the sea. A low natural sea horizon and a narrow band of textured ocean below an expansive cloud-filled sky; clouds are clearly the main subject.
Style and physics: natural documentary landscape photography, highly realistic like the physical world, authentic atmospheric perspective, physically plausible irregular cumulus forms with soft vapor edges, subtle light and shadow inside cloud masses, realistic cloud size and distance. Natural grass, roof and wall material textures, real water surface, coherent outdoor daylight and realistic camera detail without exaggerated HDR.
Constraints: exactly three independent photographs, equal-height rows touching directly. No visible sun or moon or sun/moon symbols. No faces, eyes, anthropomorphic clouds, illustration, drawing, vector art, painting, CGI, plastic rendering, fantasy, decorative motifs, text or watermark.
reviewNotes: Inspected the returned 1024x1792 image with Read. Three photorealistic edge-to-edge rows in correct order: clouds over a small hill, a house, and sea. Clouds dominate all rows; plausible vapor forms, atmospheric light and physical textures. No visible sun/moon, faces, text, watermark, borders or gutters. Actual zero-based crop boundaries measured from adjacent-row pixel differences: y=591 and y=1187 (heights 591, 596, 605); rows are near equal, not exactly equal. No cropping performed.
